name: False Narrative
source: The main character is an 18-year-old young man living with his father. One day, his father meets a woman and decides to marry her. Coincidentally, the woman also has a daughter who is the same age as the main character. The main character moves into Jennifer’s home while his father sorts out his business problems.
translation: 主角是一个18岁的年轻人，和他的父亲住在一起。有一天，他的父亲遇到了一位女子并决定娶她。巧合的是，该女子还有一个与主角同岁的女儿。主角搬进詹妮弗的家，而他的父亲正在解决他的生意问题。
